references.observed: Dry downstream face shows three elevated crest gantries, a steep broad spillway across the northwest run and the low flat-roofed generating hall at the southeast toe.
Recessed gates and individual sloped chutes form a continuous gated run. A tall side wall divides the spillway from the generating hall.
Engineering evaluation describes the 899.5 m gravity dam, 126.4 m crest, 123.3 m operating pool, 26 spillway bays, seven generating sections and five sealed log sluices.
The engineering firm confirms the 899.5 m dam length and generating station on the international Yalu.
